goal.text: MiHa is a reference-grade browser agent harness: its budget, its laws and its document graph are all machine-checked, and every claim below is proven with a negative control
goal.reason: The aim now covers the implementation and its budgets, not only the decision record

claims.text: Every relative document link and every ADR supersedes target in the decision record resolves to a file that exists, and the supersedes chain terminates without looping

review.reason: Owner directed that MiHa be its own harness and not a behavioural clone of pi: laws must carry derivations from the provider protocols, upstream's tests are not ported, and the session and trace formats are ours

claims.falsifier: A document links to a file that does not exist, or an ADR names a missing or looping supersedes target

claims.text: Every decision label referenced anywhere in the documentation is defined by an ADR heading, each ADR's labels are contiguous from D1, and no ADR defines decisions that nothing else references

review.reason: Owner directed that MiHa be its own harness and not a behavioural clone of pi: laws must carry derivations from the provider protocols, upstream's tests are not ported, and the session and trace formats are ours

claims.falsifier: A referenced decision label has no definition, an ADR skips or repeats a label, or an ADR contains decisions that nothing else references
claims.control: printf '\nSee D99 for the details.\n' >> docs/adr/0002-core-harness.md

claims.text: Every measurement stated in the research documents carries a source: either a file and line, a URL, or a caption directly above the table that declares where the numbers come from

review.reason: Owner directed that MiHa be its own harness and not a behavioural clone of pi: laws must carry derivations from the provider protocols, upstream's tests are not ported, and the session and trace formats are ours

claims.falsifier: A table row states a measurement with no source in the row and no source caption above its table
claims.control: sed -i '/^Source: measured on this machine against/,+3d' docs/research/02-scenario-runtime-landscape.md

claims.text: The published browser bundle, the per-layer code-line budgets, the runtime dependency count and the absence of any in the source all hold within the limits declared in ADR 0004

review.reason: Owner took the core design pass: the core is a pure transition system with a six-state machine, the transcript is append-only and appended by intent, the dispatch plan carries the tool it runs, and the layer budgets now reconcile with the module budgets

claims.falsifier: The browser bundle exceeds 30 000 B gzip, a layer exceeds its line budget, a runtime dependency is declared, or any appears in src/

claims.text: The event stream satisfies laws S1 to S5: events are delivered in push order exactly once, result resolves exactly once with the terminal value, events after the terminal are ignored, iteration ends after the terminal event, and no event is lost between a push and the start of iteration

review.reason: Owner took the core design pass: the core is a pure transition system with a six-state machine, the transcript is append-only and appended by intent, the dispatch plan carries the tool it runs, and the layer budgets now reconcile with the module budgets

claims.falsifier: A law is broken: order or count of delivered events changes, result resolves with the wrong value or more than once, a late event is delivered, or an event pushed before iteration is lost
claims.control: sed -i 's/this.#buffer.shift() as T/this.#buffer.pop() as T/' src/core/event-stream.ts

claims.text: The tool-parameter dialect satisfies laws C1 to C3: every value the dialect admits is accepted, every value it does not admit is rejected with a JSON Pointer path, and coercion happens only where the dialect declares it

review.reason: Owner took the core design pass: the core is a pure transition system with a six-state machine, the transcript is append-only and appended by intent, the dispatch plan carries the tool it runs, and the layer budgets now reconcile with the module budgets

claims.falsifier: A value the dialect admits is rejected, a rejected value carries no path, or a value is coerced where the dialect did not ask for coercion
claims.control: sed -i 's/} else if (schema.coerce \&\& typeof value === "string") {/} else if (typeof value === "string") {/' src/schema/dialect.ts

claims.text: The dispatch planner satisfies laws M1, M2 and M3 and policy T1: every call of a batch appears exactly once across the plan and the rejections, a call whose arguments did not arrive complete is never planned for execution, a failed tool is a result carrying isError rather than ordinary content, and an exclusive tool runs alone while shared tools around it still share a group
claims.falsifier: A call is planned and rejected at once or neither, a call with unparseable arguments reaches a group, a failure is reported as ordinary content, or an exclusive tool shares a group with another exclusive tool

claims.text: The state machine and the driver together keep laws M1, M2, M3, M4 and T4 over a whole run: every tool call of every batch receives exactly one result including on rejection, tool failure, provider error and cancellation; a call with arguments that did not arrive complete is never executed; a failed tool is a result carrying isError; a provider failure is an event rather than a throw; and the tool results are recorded in assistant order
claims.falsifier: A call is left unanswered on any path, a call with unparseable arguments reaches a group, a failure becomes ordinary content or a thrown error, or the results are recorded in completion order
claims.control: sed -i 's/const flushed = flushResults({ ...state, results }, outputs);/const flushed = { ...state, phase: "settling" as const, results: [] };/' src/core/run.ts
